sharePointSiteUrl.instruction: Replace the placeholder site URL in every listed definition with the approved target SharePoint site URL before tenant import.

escalationsListTitle.instruction: Confirm or replace the demo escalation list title consistently in all listed definitions during the controlled rebind step.

vendorReferenceListTitle.instruction: Confirm or replace the demo vendor-reference list title consistently in all listed definitions during the controlled rebind step.

connectorConnectionReferences.instruction: Use the tenant import rebind UI to replace every fixture connection reference with an approved connection for the matching connector API.

approvedPrincipalIds.instruction: Replace each synthetic principal ID in the access-matrix definition with an explicitly approved tenant principal ID before import.

approvedRoleDefinitionIds.instruction: Verify the operator and reader role-definition IDs against the target tenant and replace both values before import when they differ.

sharedMailboxBindings.instruction: Replace the synthetic mailbox address and folder resource with the approved shared mailbox and folder during connector rebind.

ingestWorkbookBindings.instruction: Replace each synthetic workbook source, drive, file, and table value with the approved queue workbook binding before enabling recurrence.
